description: Every infinite animation still animates under reduced motion. The page /reduced-motion/scan has every stylesheet the server ships, and two helpers: window.__infiniteSelectors() lists the selectors of every rule outside a prefers-reduced-motion block that animates forever, and window.__frozen(selectors) lists those of the given selectors whose element the reduce override has frozen. Motion is reduced (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce). 1. Navigate to /reduced-motion/scan. 2. Eval [...document.querySelectorAll('link[rel="stylesheet"]')].every((l) => l.sheet && l.sheet.cssRules.length > 0): it must return true (allow 15s): every shipped stylesheet loaded. 3. Eval window.__infiniteSelectors().length > 0: it must return true (no infinite animations would mean the scan is broken). 4. Eval JSON.stringify(window.__frozen(window.__infiniteSelectors())): it must return exactly "[]".
